lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: How far is Deira? I am late for work.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Deira? No problem. But the traffic is very bad today.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Please, can you go faster? I cannot lose this job.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: I will try, my friend. But look at this road.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Just... please take the short way.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Short way? That is what I am doing. You trust me, yes?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يا هلا يا هلا! أنا محمود، وهنبدأ رحلتنا مع "Yalla Fluent". النهارده، مَكَّلْ راكب تاكسي، والوقت بِيْجْرِي، ومحتاج يِتْكَلِّم عشان يِتْفَهْم! ... رَكِّزْ معايا على تلات جُمَل: "How far is Deira?" و "Please, can you go faster?" و "Please take the short way." ... ياللا نِسْمَع سوا!

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Okay, my friend. We move now. But I must ask you something. Why are you going to Deira so early?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I work at Dune and Company. I live here since two years, but I am still late sometimes. Today is very bad.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Two years? Your English is good, my friend. Do not worry. We will get there.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you. But please, can you go faster? My boss is not a patient man.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: I understand. But look — this road is full. Every car is going to Deira.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Just... please take the short way. The small streets. I know they are faster.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: The small streets? Hmm. Okay. But you must tell me — left or right at the next light?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Left. Then... go straight. Then right after the mosque. I think. I am not sure.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: You think? Okay, boss. I trust you. But if we are late, it is your map, not my driving.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Ha! Okay. Deal. Please, just... do not stop. Every minute is important.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: No stopping. I promise. Look — we are almost there. That tall building? That is Deira.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Finally! Thank you, my friend. How much is it?

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Forty-five dirhams. And good luck with your boss. Run fast, my friend!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Shukran — I mean, thank you! Have a good day!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بَرَافُو عَلِيك يا مَكَّلْ! ... سَمِعْتوا الجُمَل الحِلْوَة دي؟ ياللا نْفَكِّكْها مَع بَعْض. ... أَوَّل جُمْلَة: How far is Deira? يَعْنِي: الدِّيرَة بَعِيدَة قَد إِيه؟ ... بِنِسْتَخْدِمْها لَمَّا تِسْأَل عَن المَسَافَة، زَيّ: How far is your office from here?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تانِي جُمْلَة: Please, can you go faster? يَعْنِي: لَو سَمَحْت، تِقْدَر تِمْشِي أَسْرَع؟ ... كَلِمَة please هِيَّ السِّر... لأ، مَفِيش سِر! هِيَّ الأَدَب. ... لَمَّا تِسْأَل بِـ please، النَّاس بِتِساعْدَك أَكْتَر. ... مِثَال: Please, can you help me?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تالِت جُمْلَة: Please take the short way. يَعْنِي: لَو سَمَحْت، خُد الطَّرِيق القَصِير. ... take هِنَا يَعْنِي خُد، مُش وَخُد! ... زَيّ: Please take the stairs, not the elevator.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَدُلْوَقْتِي، غَلْطَة صَغِيرَة مِن مَكَّلْ. ... هُوَ قال: I live here since two years. ... المُشْكِلَة؟ كَلِمَة since بِنِسْتَخْدِمْها مَع الزَّمَن المُسْتَمِرّ، زَيّ since 2022. ... لَكِن مَع مُدَّة زَمَن، زَيّ سَنَتَيْن، بِنِقُول for. ... فَالصَّح: I have lived here for two years.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: خُد بِالك مِنِّي: since = مِن وَقْت مُعَيَّن، for = لِمُدَّة. ... مِثَال: I have worked here for three months. ... تَمَام؟ دُلْوَقْتِي، تَعالوا نِشُوف مَكَّلْ في الشُّغْل، وِنْشُوف هُوَ حَيِتْعَامَل إِزَّاي مَع نُور!

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Deira, my friend. Dune and Company is right there. The big glass building.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes! I see it. Thank you. Please, can you stop near the front door?

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Of course. Here, sir. Forty-five dirhams. And take your time with the door.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Here is fifty. Keep the change, my friend. You saved my day.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Thank you! Good luck, boss. Do not forget your bag on the seat.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Oh! Yes. My bag. Thank you. I have lived in Dubai for two years, and I still forget my bag!
lines.direction: sheepish laugh, then a small proud beat

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Ha! Two years, my friend. Dubai makes everyone busy. Now go, go! Your boss is waiting.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. I am going. Have a good day, sir. And please drive safe.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Always safe! Yalla, run!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I am running... but wait. Why is the front desk so busy? That is Tarek. He is laughing with the girl at reception. He is never early.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: Macal! You are late today. Tarek came in an hour ago. He said he wanted to speak to your manager. Alone.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: He came in early? To speak to my manager? About what, I wonder.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بَرَافُو عَلِيكوا يا جَمَاعَة! ... دُلْوَقْتِي، رَاجِعْ مَعَايَا: How far is Deira? ... Please, can you go faster? ... Please take the short way. ... وَكَمَان، فَاكِر: I have lived here for two years. ... for مَع المُدَّة، وَ since مَع وَقْت مُعَيَّن.
lines.direction: warm, recap energy, slow on key phrases

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الحَلْقَة النَّهَارْدَة هِيَّ: ... Please take the short way. ... كَلِمَة please بِتَخَلِّي الكَلَام أَدَب، وَالنَّاس بِتِساعْدَك أَكْتَر!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: لَو عَجَبَكُوا الحَلْقَة، ... تَعالوا عَلى التِلِيجْرَام، وَاشْتَرِكُوا في البُودْكاست، وَاكْتُبُوا لِي: إِيه أَصْعَب عِبَارَة عِنْدَكُوا؟ ... أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَبِسْتَناكُوا هُنَا!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَمَرَّة جَايَة... مَكَّلْ دَاخِل الشُّغْل، بِنُور، وَتَارِك عَلى نَار! ... يَاللا، كَمِّلُوا مَعَايَا!
